about_the_game:
Deadzone Aeon is an atmospheric survival shooter set in a world where humanity stands on the edge of collapse. Players must navigate treacherous zones, scavenge for resources, and face unspeakable dangers in this fantasy sci-fi survival adventure. With an expansive inventory system, modular weapons, and deep equipment customization, you’ll forge your own path to survival. You will even compete against other players in the treacherous PVPVE environment, fighting for loot, with a unique karma element to easily determine who is friend or foe.

The story explores timeless themes of power, loss, and purpose. As you journey through Deadzone Aeon, you’ll uncover fragments of a world that has been forgotten by time itself. The choices you make, and the alliances you form, will shape your place in a world full of mystery.

content_descriptors.notes: Game contains shooting blocky human-zombies, blocky humans & other species, which contains blood & violence. Contains depictions of drug and alcohol use.

short_description: Deadzone Aeon is a multiplayer survival-driven fantasy open world with story elements. Mixed within the classic online survival genre, delve into a PVPVE story where deception runs deep and every step draws you closer to the forgotten truths that shaped existence itself.
